chunks: 1554 - And Hammad ibn Isa narrated from Najiyah, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام:

That he would, whenever he intended to purchase a servant, an animal, a light need, or a small matter, perform istikharah with Allah, Mighty and Majestic, concerning it seven times; and when it was a serious matter, he would perform istikharah with Allah one hundred times.

key_terms.الْعَبْدِ: a servant or slave being purchased

ai.seo_question: How many times should istikharah be performed for small matters and serious matters according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of Imam Abu Abdillah Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام in seeking Allah’s guidance before decisions. It indicates that istikharah was performed in proportion to the significance of the matter, with more repetition for weightier affairs.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1554 - Hammad ibn Isa narrated from Najiyah, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that "

Whenever He (as) intended to purchase a servant, an animal, or a light matter, or something of little importance, he would perform istikhara (seek Allah’s (swt) guidance) seven times.
But if it was a serious matter, he would perform istikhara one hundred times”.
